llm_fields.description: The scheme provides subsidies to members of state religious minority communities to start or improve small‑scale handicraft, service sector, and agro‑based activities, with support from nationalized or scheduled banks.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must belong to the State Religious Minority Community, be a permanent resident of the State, be aged between 18 and 55 years, have a family annual income not exceeding Rs 81,000 in rural areas and Rs 1,03,000 in urban areas, have no family member employed by a State/Central/Government PSU, and must not have previously availed a loan from KMDC.
